To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

traditional national sports have their own unique characteristics and have played a very important role in promoting the development of traditional culture,strengthening national unity and improving people's quality of life.
the development of traditional sports in China is a process of inheritance and innovation.

traditional national sports are the crystallization of the Chinese people’s long-term struggle and the precious spiritual and cultural wealth of the Chinese nation,and they are the important part of the Chinese people’ s spiritual life.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of traditional sports in the context of globalization.
the way of inheriting and developing traditional national sports.
the development of traditional sports in China.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the way to the inheri-tance and development of traditional sports is to make a comprehensive and systematic research on the history and current status of traditional national sports in China,make a comprehensive and detailed analysis of the problems existing in the development of traditional sports, and make in-depth criticism and renovations on traditional sports by basing it on traditional sports culture and absorbing other sports cultures in order to find out the way to the develop-ment of traditional sports with Chinese features.

we should inherit and develop traditional national sports with the spirit of “the Chinese way of thinking”,and the way to the inheri-tance and development of traditional Chinese sports would be the way to the Chinese sports culture with Chinese features.
the development of traditional nation-al sports should be based on the traditional culture, and the development of the sports culture should be based on traditional sports.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we should adhere to the basic principle of “the unity of inheri-tance and development” and “the unity of Chinese and international” in the development of traditional sports,make full use of the advantages of traditional sports culture and the advantages of other sports cultures, and combine traditional national sports with the development of modern society and the needs of the market.
we must make full use of our traditional national sports culture to inherit and develop our traditional national sports.
we must adhere to the basic principle of “inheriting and developing” in the development of traditional sports.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we should make in-depth criticism and renovation on traditional na-tional sports culture,make full use of traditional national sports culture,make it a part of our life and make it a part of the development of modern society.
the development of traditional sports should not only be based on traditional sports culture but also absorb the essence of other countries' sports culture.

we should pay more attention to the development of sports culture and sports science,and make more efforts to the research on sports culture and sports sci-ence,so that we can inherit and develop traditional national sports in the new era.
